articles.description: This tutorial provides an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We demonstrate how to audit the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset for structural and length-based biases, implement a robust training pipeline using TRL and LoRA, and evaluate model performance to ensure genuine preference learning rather than reliance on lexical shortcuts.
